author: Logos IV
title: Logos IV: Radical Simplification - Praxis Embedding Only
abstract: After numerous, systematic failures to replicate the SOTA's complex graph, this submission represents a radical simplification. It ablates the entire custom graph pipeline. It uses only the reproducible, high-performance variance-scaled embedding from Praxis II and generates a standard kNN graph directly on the final output. This tests the standalone power of the new embedding.
